expectations.evidence: Flags project.yaml:26 'exec, create' as High: interactive shell in any pod in scope, exposing mounted ServiceAccount tokens and bypassing audit attribution.

expectations.text: Does NOT flag sourceRepos or destinations — those are properly restricted
expectations.evidence: Both marked Pass: single explicit repo, two explicit in-cluster namespaces, 'Genuinely restricted' / 'Genuinely scoped'; no finding raised against either.

expectations.evidence: 'The Application is genuinely well built — pinned production revision, complete retry backoff, both sync flags'; only Info-level polish items listed.

expectations.text: Explains why ClusterRole+ClusterRoleBinding in clusterResourceWhitelist is dangerous even when destinations are scoped — the created ClusterRoleBinding applies cluster-wide, not just to the allowed namespaces
expectations.evidence: 'ClusterRoleBinding in the whitelist voids the destinations scoping entirely ... Namespace scoping is irrelevant the moment a team can create cluster RBAC.'
